correctness.rationale: Direct congruence gives 2x2 SPD block with diagonal theta,b and offdiagonal sqrt(theta*v), and m copies of c. Since lambda_+>b>c, kappa=lambda_+/min(lambda_-,c); lambda_-=c iff theta(d-v)=cd, possible uniquely for v<d. Before collision block condition number decreases up to theta=b by maximizing theta(b-v)/(theta+b)^2, after collision lambda_+/c strictly increases. This establishes unique theta*=min(b,theta_coll), transition v1=d²/b and both closed minimum formulas. Three eigenvalues imply generic exact CG minimal-polynomial degree 3; two eigenvalues yield universal <=2 CG steps. Independent rational samples validate numeric examples but not the entire real parameter domain.
